question: Does a direct dated query of the official Gazeta interface expose a contemporaneous BLUME identity or a pertinent original document?
prior_route_closed: Phase17 used only an external web index. Earlier BOE readings checked specific general documents. No direct Gazeta query found in the reviewed own ledgers.
access_rule: Open the official homepage once and follow only an observed Gazeta/search href. Read the linked public form once, through HTTP if needed to inspect action/controls. At most two interface/help openings total; no guessed endpoints, parameters or services. Close on block, account requirement or unverifiable controls.

queries.field: Observed text field, declaring exact scope. Do not call title/index text a complete body search.
queries.required: Verifiable date controls and form syntax.

queries.optional_rule: If first query returns more than20 results, add Salamanca using observed supported controls. If zero, query Salamanca alone with the same dates as a response control. If1–20 or syntax unverifiable, omit.

document_rule: Only period1936–1938 records whose title/fragment indicates BLUME identity, firm, registry or address. Prioritize explicit Salamanca link, then distance to8Jan1937, then source order. A control-only document must be declared and consumes the same cap. A bare homonym or separate-list cooccurrence does not identify the recipient.
preservation: New files only in work/primary_history_20261003. Record exact requested URLs/fields, declared counts, actual read scope, response hashes and errors. External bodies/scans remain local. Distinguish observable tool requests from any unknown tool-internal network work; no retries or budget extensions.
negative_limit: A negative is limited to the field, filters, interface and records actually inspected. It does not establish absence from the full corpus, telegraphic-address registers or Salamanca archives.
